_about: THE probe policy for every third-party network touch this suite makes (decision 4, CLOSED 2026-09-10; PLAN-v3 SS 2.11): the discovery-live sampler (conformance/ci/discovery_live.py, D4-08), the monthly state-of-UCP tracker (ops/tools/state_of_ucp_scan.py) and the ucpchecker comparison (D4-09) read it. Discovery-only: GET /.well-known/ucp, nothing else; never a catalog read (decision 4b: NOT NOW), never a mutating, signed, replayed or negative probe; runs ONLY on the owner's machine (never in GitHub Actions; captures are private and never Actions artifacts); a named, contactable User-Agent; per-UA robots.txt honoured; <=1 request/s, <=1 fetch per store per day, <=50 stores per day; 10 s timeout; no redirects followed (the redirect itself is graded); raw captures pruned after 90 days, aggregates only in public.
user_agent: spck-conformance-research/0.1 (+https://spck.dev/research; read-only discovery probe; contact vishal@katyal.ai)

frame.note: the pinned CC-BY dataset state_of_ucp_scan.py already uses; ucpchecker /api/ is never touched
